svg.title: Sessions: access + refresh tokens
svg.desc: Login: bcrypt compare, store sha256 of the refresh token in Redis with a 7 day TTL, return a 15 minute access JWT and an opaque refresh token. Ordinary requests carry the JWT and are verified with the key alone. Refresh: look up the hashed token, delete it, store a new one and return a new pair.
svg.text: Short-lived JWT checked locally; opaque refresh token rotated on every use.

g.text: every request: verified with the key alone, no Redis round trip

svg.text: Refresh tokens are 256-bit random values, so sha256(token) is enough. If Redis is down, /auth/refresh fails closed with 401.
